item.title: New recipe: Daily Bread: Bible Verses
item.description: Created by community member barrymichaeldoyle. Enable and do to others what you would have them do to you.
item.content:encoded:
Daily Bread: Bible Verses : Daily Bible verses in 3 languages

By Barry Michael Doyle · life, personal

Created by community member barrymichaeldoyle. Enable and do to others what you would have them do to you.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

An independent TRMNL Bible recipe. Scripture comes from the <a href="https://worldenglish.bible/" class="underline">World English Bible (WEB)</a>, <a href="https://ebible.org/bible/details.php?id=fraLSG" class="underline">Louis Segond 1910</a> and <a href="https://ebible.org/bible/details.php?id=spaRV1909" class="underline">Reina Valera 1909</a>. All three translations are public domain. Their original wording and spelling are preserved; whitespace is normalized and publisher footnote markers are omitted for display. Each chapter QR code opens the selected translation on eBible.org.<br><br>Daily Bread brings daily Bible verses to your TRMNL, with one complete passage to carry into your day. Keep Scripture in view at home or at your desk, with a distinctive cross and space to read and reflect.<br><br>Explore 108 curated passages in each of three languages: English, French and Spanish. Choose one or several of nine everyday themes, including family, relationships, work, generosity, decisions, worry, loss, gratitude and prayer. Leave all themes selected for a varied daily reading.<br><br>Daily Bread changes passages each day by default, following your TRMNL timezone. Set a faster refresh rate, down to hourly, for new passages more often. An optional QR code opens the full chapter in your chosen translation, helping you read each passage in context.<br><br>English uses the World English Bible, French uses Louis Segond 1910, and Spanish uses Reina Valera 1909. All three are public-domain translations, preserving the publisher's Scripture wording. The collection is included with the recipe, so you need no Bible API key or separate Bible subscription. Full-screen and all three mashup layouts are included.<br><br>Install Daily Bread, choose your language, and start with a passage a day.

Install the recipe on trmnl.com

item.title: New recipe: Wind Master
item.description: Created by community member _xacto_. Enable and get blown away by the layout.
item.content:encoded:
Wind Master : Live wind, gusts & hourly forecast

By _xacto_ · environment, nature

Created by community member _xacto_. Enable and get blown away by the layout.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

Wind Master was made to keep an eye on the wind at the lake. Forecasts come from <a href="https://open-meteo.com">Open-Meteo</a>, a free weather service, so there's nothing to sign up for.<br><br>Wind Master puts the wind where you'll actually see it. Large numbers show the current wind speed and gusts, with a plain-English description from the Beaufort scale, from "Calm" to "Gale". A compass needle and a heading like "SSE, from 164°" tell you which way it's blowing, and the title bar shows when the reading was taken.<br><br>Below that, a chart of the next 8, 12 or 24 hours shows whether the wind is building or dying down. A dashed line tracks the gusts. You can add gust numbers, or small arrows showing which way the wind turns each hour.<br><br>Search for your town or address, pick mph, km/h, m/s or knots, and give the location a name. Forecasts come from Open-Meteo, a free weather service, so there's no account or API key to set up.<br><br>Handy for sailing, kiteboarding, paddling, fishing, flying drones, or deciding whether today is a good day to rake leaves. Full, half and quarter-screen layouts fit into mashups, and it stays crisp on both the TRMNL OG and TRMNL X, in light or dark mode.

Install the recipe on trmnl.com

From the author (About This Plugin)

Air quality for all five of Singapore's NEA reporting regions, drawn as a halftone map of the island. item.title: New recipe: On the Move: Animal Migration Tracker
item.description: Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and take flight (or foot).
item.content:encoded:
On the Move: Animal Migration Tracker : See where migrating animals are now

By IsarWorks · discovery, life

Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and take flight (or foot).

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

Follow migrating animals on a map and see where they travel throughout the year. On the Move turns wildlife tracking data into a simple window onto animal migration, showing the journeys of birds and other animals as they move between breeding, feeding, and wintering grounds.<br><br>Choose from species including white storks, cranes, honey buzzards, turtle doves, gulls, shrikes, wheatears, curlews, hawks, vultures, a blue whale, and a loggerhead turtle. When an animal has a working GPS tag, the map shows its latest recorded position and the date it was recorded.<br><br>For species without a current GPS position, On the Move uses a full year of published tracking data to show where that species is typically found on the same day of the year. This lets you follow seasonal migration even when there is no current location available.<br><br>A thick line shows the journey already travelled, while a thin line shows the typical route ahead. Each screen also includes the animal's name, location, timing, and a rotating fact about the species or individual.<br><br>Choose a single species, several species, or let the whole collection take turns. On TRMNL X, Flock View lets you view several animals at once.<br><br>

Install (don't Fork!) to receive future updates.<br><br>

Tracking data (Movebank, CC0 and CC BY studies only; used under their licences, without warranties):<br>
White Stork: Wolfgang Fiedler, <a href="https://www.movebank.org/cms/webapp?gwt_fragment=page=studies,path=study173641633">LifeTrack White Stork Vorarlberg</a>, CC BY<br>
White Stork: Wolfgang Fiedler, <a href="https://www.movebank.org/cms/webapp?gwt_fragment=page=studies,path=study24442409">LifeTrack White Stork Bavaria</a>, CC BY<br>

item.title: New recipe: MLB Playoffs
item.description: Created by community member . Enable and hope your homerun doesn't hit the roof.
item.content:encoded:
MLB Playoffs : MLB postseason bracket

By Creator #45900 · sports

Created by community member . Enable and hope your homerun doesn't hit the roof.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

MLB postseason bracket with team logos, series records, next game times and live scores.<br/><br/>MLB blocks TRMNL's servers, so this plugin needs a small relay script on your home network (a NAS or any Linux machine) that posts data to the plugin's webhook. See the <a href="https://github.com/adamconde/trmnl-plugins/blob/main/plugins/mlb-playoffs/README.md">setup instructions</a>.<br/><br/>Version 1.2.0<br><br>MLB Playoffs puts the full MLB postseason bracket on your TRMNL. It shows every series from the Wild Card round through the World Series.<br><br>Each matchup shows team logos, the series record as filled dots, and the date and time of the next game in your own timezone. Start times MLB hasn't announced yet show as TBD. When a game is in progress, the card shows a LIVE badge with the current score and inning. Finished series show the result, with the winner in bold and the eliminated team grayed out.<br><br>The full-screen view shows the whole bracket, with the American League on the left, the National League on the right, and the World Series in the middle. Once every Division Series matchup is set, the Wild Card round drops off to give the remaining series more room. Half-screen and quarter-screen views show just the current round, so it fits into a mashup alongside your other plugins. The bracket follows the current season automatically. In the off-season it shows "No postseason schedule yet" until MLB publishes the next bracket.<br><br>Setup takes one extra step. MLB blocks requests from cloud servers, including TRMNL's, so a small relay script has to run on an always-on machine on your home network, such as a Synology NAS or any Linux box. Every 10 minutes, it fetches the bracket from MLB and sends it to your plugin's webhook. The script needs only Python, with nothing else to install. Step-by-step instructions are in the GitHub README linked from this recipe.

Install the recipe on trmnl.com

item.title: New recipe: Downstream: Watershed Explorer
item.description: Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and go tubing down the river.
item.content:encoded:
Downstream: Watershed Explorer : Follow a raindrop from town to sea

By IsarWorks · nature, education

Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and go tubing down the river.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

Discover where water flows from towns around the world with Downstream, a constantly changing river and water flow map for your TRMNL.<br><br>Every 15 minutes, Downstream picks a different town and follows the path a raindrop would take from there, stream by stream and river by river. See the entire route on a map, from the starting stream to its final destination: a sea, lake, or sometimes somewhere underground.<br><br>The map shows every named stream, river, and lake along the journey, together with the total distance and a rough estimate of how long the water takes to travel. Some routes are only a few kilometres long. Others cross entire countries and travel thousands of kilometres before reaching the sea.<br><br> River network: <a href="https://www.hydrosheds.org/hydroatlas">HydroATLAS</a> (Linke et al. 2019; Lehner & Grill 2013) and lake residence times: <a href="https://www.hydrosheds.org/products/hydrolakes">HydroLAKES</a> (Messager et al. 2016), both <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>, simplified. Towns: <a href="https://www.geonames.org/">GeoNames</a> (CC BY 4.0). Stream, river and lake names and the map: © <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap contributors</a> (ODbL). Seas: Natural Earth. Dams, canals and city drains are not modelled.

Install the recipe on trmnl.com

Texas Power Grid : Charts related to the ERCOT grid

By Creator #35331 · news, analytics

Created by community member . Enable and even the recipes are bigger from Texas.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

The "Texas Power Grid" plugin shows a collection of ERCOT information including wind and solar generation, system-wide prices, energy storage resource output, and ancillary services. The display shown on the TRMNL device can be chosen via the dropdown below. This plugin is not affiliated with ERCOT Inc. and uses publicly available data. <br><br>See additional displays at <a href="https://trmnl.ditherdata.com/" target="_blank">https://trmnl.ditherdata.com/</a>. <br><br>This plugin displays charts and metrics for the ERCOT interconnection, the power grid serving most of Texas. <br><br><b>(Update: 10/4/2026)</b> Introduced the Supply and Demand display which shows the ERCOT load and available capacity. <br><br>Use the Display option to choose from the following views: <br><br><b>• Supply and Demand:</b> ERCOT's load, available capacity and net load for today, actual and forecast, or the six-day forecast of load and capacity. Net Load can be shown using the available display options. <br><br><b>• Wind and Solar:</b> Actual wind and solar generation for today, plus forecasts through the end of tomorrow. Series can be stacked or overlaid. <br><br><b>• System-Wide Prices:</b> Individual plots of hub and load zone prices, comparing today's real-time price with the day-ahead price. An all-prices view summarizes every hub and load zone in a single display. <br><br><b>• Energy Storage:</b> Fleet-wide behavior of Energy Storage Resources (ESRs). Optional toggles add a "net energy" line showing cumulative ESR energy as a proxy for state of charge, and a box plot overlay comparing current behavior to the previous 30 days. <br><br><b>• Ancillary Services:</b> Regulation services over the past two hours.
